sources.scope_note: The prior authoritative edition is retained because it prints the high-scale inverse-coupling endpoint explicitly; the 2026 review retains the running relation and direct-observation statement but does not print the same endpoint in that form.

measurement_scope.strong_running: Complete PDG 2026 Table 9.1, full Figure 9.4 custody, exact Q=1.37 GeV and m_Z-scale rows, printed uncertainty and the page-43 energy-dependence conclusion.
measurement_scope.electromagnetic_running: All five PDG 2026 alpha(0) rows, all eleven Table 10.1 hadronic-running rows, the published scale relation, direct LEP observations and the explicit PDG 2025 Z-scale endpoint.
measurement_scope.formal_convergence_boundary: The exact common-support Fold convergence theorem is a sealed standing prediction. No available measurement is relabelled as direct observation of all four Fold sectors at arbitrary generated depth.

transcription_protocol: The official PDFs were downloaded from the current and prior PDG endpoints and hashed. Printed pages 15, 16, 19, 33, 41, 42 and 43 were text-extracted and visually checked. Every printed decimal used by the comparator is retained as a string and converted only to exact rational intervals after the formal prediction seal. The complete QCD figure remains preserved by source hash; unprinted plot coordinates are not reverse-engineered or invented.
